title: Sparameters
text: Model RF complex baseband S-parameters in Simulink, 1 input, 1 output, {First plot type} sets Plot type; {Data source}, {File} sets the two-port Touchstone data file, {Sparameter object} uses sparameters object as data source, {Rational object} uses rational object as data source, {Carrier frequency (Hz)} sets the carrier frequency at which S-parameters are, {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted, {Modeling domain}, {Solver} sets the time-domain solvers, {Pole fitting options} sets the rational fit fitting options Share all, {Rational arguments} sets the rational fit arguments to control the fit, {FIR filter length} sets the filter length of 1-D digital filter, {Impulse response arguments} sets the input arguments to plot impulse response, {Step response arguments} sets the input arguments to plot step response, {First plot y-axis units} sets the y-axis units of first plot Magnitude, {Second Plot type} plots type of second plot, {Second plot y-axis units} sets the y-axis units of second plot Magnitude, {X-axis frequency points (Hz)} sets the frequency points to plot S-parameter data, {X-axis scale}, {Y-axis scale} and {Plot Sparameter characteristics} plots S-parameters data. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Time-dependent input signal real scalar | real column | complex scalar | complex column

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Time-dependent output signal complex scalar | complex column

params.name: Data source
params.values: Data source to model RF complex baseband S-parameters file (default) | sparameters | rational

params.name: File
params.values: Two-port Touchstone data file unitygain.s2p (default) | character vector

params.name: Sparameter object
params.values: Use sparameters object as data source sparameters(’unitygain.s2p’) (default)

params.name: Rational object
params.values: Use rational object as data source rational(’unitygain.s2p’,’TendsToZero’,false) (default)

params.name: Carrier frequency (Hz)
params.values: Carrier frequency at which S-parameters are modeled 1000000000 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation

params.name: Modeling domain
params.values: Modeling domain Time (Fixed step) (default) | Time (Continuous) | Frequency (Digital filter)

params.name: Solver
params.values: Time-domain solvers NDF2 (default) | Trapezoidal | Backward Euler | ode15s | ode23s | ode23t (trap) | ode23tb (trap+BE)

params.name: Pole fitting options
params.values: Rational fit fitting options Share all poles (default) | Fit individually | Share poles by columns

params.name: Rational arguments
params.values: Rational fit arguments to control the fit { ’Tolerance’,-40,’TendsToZero’,false,’MaxPoles’,48,’Qlimit’,inf } (default) | cell array

params.name: FIR filter length
params.values: Filter length of 1-D digital filter 128 (default) | real positive integer

params.name: First plot type
params.values: Plot type S21 (default) | Phase delay | Group delay | Impulse response | Step response

params.name: Impulse response arguments
params.values: Input arguments to plot impulse response [ 1e-11, 1e4] (default) | two-element vector

params.name: Step response arguments
params.values: Input arguments to plot step response [ 1e-11, 1e4, 1e-10 ] (default) | three-element vector

params.name: First plot y-axis units
params.values: Y-axis units of first plot Magnitude (dB) (default) | Magnitude (linear) | Angle (degrees) | Real | Imaginary

params.name: Second Plot type
params.values: Plot type of second plot None (default) | S21 | Phase delay | Group delay | Impulse response | Step response

params.name: Second plot y-axis units
params.values: Y-axis units of second plot Magnitude (dB) (default) | Magnitude (linear) | Angle (degrees) | Real | Imaginary

params.name: X-axis frequency points (Hz)
params.values: Frequency points to plot S-parameter data logspace(8,10,2001) (default) | positive real vector

params.name: X-axis scale
params.values: Linear or logarithmic X-axis scale Linear (default) | Logarithmic

params.name: Y-axis scale
params.values: Linear or logarithmic Y-axis scale Linear (default) | Logarithmic

params.name: Plot Sparameter characteristics
params.values: Plot S-parameters data button
